title: Instrument
description: One tradable market on one venue, with its price/quantity grid. CONTRACT-DEFINED, NOT YET IMPLEMENTED IN A CANONICAL ENTITY: no Instrument type exists in the repo. The id convention is 'exchange:market_type:BASE/QUOTE', evidenced by the executor fixture 'binance:spot:BTC/USDT', and the grid rounding exists (apps/executor/internal/risk/risk.go RoundQuantityDown). NO PRODUCER MINTS IT and no service serves it over HTTP. Closed object: the field set is fixed by this schema, and additionalProperties is false because an unknown grid parameter is a schema error rather than something to ignore. Absent-vs-zero rule: an empty grid string or null means 'the venue did not report it', never 0 - contract_size excepted, which must be positive ('a zero would silently zero out every notional').

instrument_id.description: Canonical id. Convention today: 'exchange:market_type:BASE/QUOTE' (src fixture 'binance:spot:BTC/USDT'). Consumers MUST treat it as opaque.

base_asset.description: Reference-by-id form of the Go struct's bare symbol string.

exchange.description: Venue name as spelled in code ('binance'), lowercase by convention.

exchange_symbol.description: The symbol EXACTLY as the venue spells it ('BTCUSDT'); never the canonical form.

min_quantity.description: Null when the venue does not report it (the Go empty string).

contract_size.description: Contract multiplier applied to quantity to get notional; '1' for spot. MUST be positive.

price_precision.description: Decimal places the venue prints for prices; 0 is legal.

max_leverage.description: Venue leverage ceiling; the Go int field, 1 = no leverage.

market_type.description: Frozen pair: exactly these two values, nothing else. The executor's TS union is the same two values (apps/web/src/lib/executor-request-defs.ts MarketType) and the API's Go enum is apps/api/internal/accounts/exchange/account.go MarketType.
